name: Echo spec and scaffold integrated
instruction: A TaskFlow progress comment for the Echo agent-harness build task.

content.body: Integrated the first two workstreams into main. Delta produced the OpenAPI and hybrid semantics docs; I corrected route drift so the spec uses the locked /v1/sessions/{id}/runs shape and DELETE lifecycle operations. Forge produced the Python scaffold; I corrected model and route naming to match the agreed Session/Run/Message/Backend contract. Verification on main: uv run pytest -> 13 passed; specs/openapi.yaml parses as YAML. Latest main commit: 5e5e399.
